scripts.text:
[King of Prontera]
Hello, can you help me?
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉國王]
你好，能幫個忙嗎？

scripts.text: Sure, what can I do?
scripts.translation: 當然，需要做什麼？

scripts.text: Sorry, I'm busy.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我很忙

scripts.text:
[King of Prontera]
Ok, that's fine, I'm sure someone else will help.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉國王]
好的，沒關係，我相信會有其他人幫忙的。

scripts.text:
[King of Prontera]
Thank you. Well, my daughter next to me is a little rowdy...
If you get her these items I'm sure she'll calm down.
I'll give you my crown or my sword as a reward.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉國王]
謝謝。嗯，我旁邊的女兒有點調皮...
如果你能給她這些物品，我相信她會安靜下來的。
我會把我的王冠或劍作為獎勵給你。

scripts.text: What do you need?
scripts.translation: 你需要什麼？

scripts.text: I have the items!
scripts.translation: 我有這些物品！

scripts.text: Forget it.
scripts.translation: 算了

[普隆德拉國王]
如果你能幫我收集：
 ~ ^0055FF{0}^000000x {1}
我就把我的{2}送給你。

[普隆德拉國王]
如果你能幫我收集：
我就把我的{0}送給你。

scripts.text:
[King of Prontera]
What item do you want?
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉國王]
你想要哪個物品？

scripts.text: Crown
scripts.translation: 王冠

scripts.text: Sword
scripts.translation: 劍

scripts.text:
[King of Prontera]
You're missing something.
Come back after you get ALL the items.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉國王]
你還缺一些東西。
集齊所有物品後再回來吧。

scripts.text:
[King of Prontera]
THANK YOU SOO MUCH!!
This will surely calm her down.
As promised, here is my {0}
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉國王]
太感謝你了！
這些東西肯定能讓她安靜下來。
這是答應給你的{0}。

scripts.text:
[King of Prontera]
Ok, that's fine, I'm sure someone else will help.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉國王]
好的，沒關係，我相信會有其他人幫忙的。

scripts.text:
[King's Daughter]
Hmph, I hate my dad right now!!
scripts.translation:
[國王的女兒]
哼，我現在最討厭爸爸了！

scripts.text: Why?
scripts.translation: 為什麼？

scripts.text: Whatever...
scripts.translation: 隨便吧...

scripts.text:
[King's Daughter]
FINE THEN! Hmph!!
scripts.translation:
[國王的女兒]
那就算了！哼！

scripts.text:
[King's Daughter]
Well, he won't give me what I want!!
He's the King of Prontera. He should be able to get me ANYTHING!!!
scripts.translation:
[國王的女兒]
他就是不肯給我想要的東西！
他可是普隆德拉的國王，應該什麼都能給我才對！
